title: Insurer & Financial Partner Portal
description: Village-level groundwater risk scores, aggregated trends, and authorized API access.
grantedAreasDescription: Villages and regions your organization has been authorized to monitor.
privacyProtectedMessage: Statistics masked because fewer than 3 consenting wells exist in this village.
disclaimerNotice: Notice: The risk_v1 score is indicative and for macro risk assessment only. It does not constitute formal underwriting or actuarial advice.
termsBody: All data is provided under strict farmer privacy covenants. Insurers and financial partners agree to only access aggregated statistics and never attempt to re-identify individual wells or landowners.
apiKeysDescription: Manage authenticated keys for the JalMaps Insurer Data API v1.
secretOneTimeNotice: Make sure to copy your API secret now. You won't be able to see it again!
